title: Pure-tensor component formula for the constructed cochain comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme and P,L,I integer-indexed O_X-module complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For an arbitrary degree-zero cochain c from P to Hom(L,I) [def-pur-hom-complex], restrict the degree-n component of the constructed normalizedTensorHomCochains X P L I 0 c [lem-pc-normalized-tensor-hom-cochains] to the summand P^p tensor L^r of Tot(P tensor L), p+r=n [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. This restriction equals the ordinary sheaf symmetry P^p tensor L^r to L^r tensor P^p followed by the inverse sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction applied to c^p followed by homTensorProjection of the r-factor [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. This is only a degree-zero cochain component equation: no cocycle, differential, bijection, or homotopy descent is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A90 (lemma-compose), degreewise evaluation; sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction

proof.text: Prove the global-cochain component calculation over an abstract site and ring sheaf for an arbitrary degreewise map satisfying HomTensorCurryCondition. Eliminate the input cochain using surjectivity of normalizedHomGlobalCochains, so its preimage section is an abstract variable; cancel symm_apply_apply and rewrite both components using normalizedHomGlobalCochains_v. Keep both projection APIs locally irreducible and identify them once using the proved generic normalized_projection_eq. Reindex the degreewise pure-tensor equation by substitution and apply it directly at the identity slice object, without duplicating its evaluation terms. The public theorem specializes this proved generic calculation to homTensorDegreewiseMap and its specification.

Prove the sheaf tensor comparison respects braiding using braiding naturality and the braided sheafification tensorator. Apply the underlying sheafification-unit naturality to get the corresponding equation for homTensorCurrySectionMap. The tensorHomEquiv inverse identity, rewritten with tensorHomEquiv_val, identifies its presheaf pullback with presheaf uncurrying. To prove equality of sheaf tensor maps, precompose with the inverse tensor comparison, use injectivity of the sheafification homEquiv, and test the resulting presheaf linear maps on pure tensors. Proved generic evaluation lemmas expose the normalized factor and braided presheaf uncurrying before specializing module arguments. After explicitly exposing composition, their evaluations reduce to the degreewise equation from step 1. Monoidal structures and normalized equivalences are locally irreducible to avoid repeated expansion. The final step directly applies the reindexed equation without duplicating its local evaluations. These are ten proved private helpers; no intermediate admission is used.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedTensorHomCochains_component (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (c : Cochain P (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L I) 0)
    (p r n : ℤ) (h : p + r = n) (h' : r + p = n) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory X.sheaf
    HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P L (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p r n h ≫
        (normalizedTensorHomCochains X P L I 0 c).v n n (add_zero n) =
      (β_ (P.X p) (L.X r)).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (L.X r) (P.X p) (I.X n)).symm
          (c.v p p (add_zero p) ≫ homTensorProjection X.sheaf L I p r n h')
